description_en: Refreshes information about the associated data table from the remote database
description_zh: 从远程数据库刷新当前所关联的数据表信息
kebab_example: aliyun dataanalysisgbi resync-table --workspace-id llm-2v3934xtp49esw64 --table-id-key table-AAAAAAAAFQBwSLJkUj4CYg --keep true --region cn-hangzhou
name: ResyncTable

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud Model Studio workspace ID used in the current request
parameters.help_zh: 当前请求所使用的阿里云百炼业务空间id
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the data table
parameters.name: table_id_key

parameters.help_en:
Enable "Keep and Add." Set to true to enable.

Keep and Add: For tables with this option enabled, Xiyan retains information about already associated columns and adds information about unassociated columns
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启'保留并新增"，true表示开启

保留并新增：对于选择“保留并新增"的表，析言将保留已关联列的信息，同时补充未关联列的信息
parameters.name: keep
